integration_policy.tier_1: Routine reversible unprotected housekeeping/tooling; exact-head CI required; C review optional; D integrates.
integration_policy.tier_2: Substantive evidence, prioritization, canonical registry, significant analysis/code, or decision product; exact-head CI plus current independent C-VERDICT required for A/B producer work; D integrates.
integration_policy.tier_3: Protected/security/governance/licensing/constitutional/agent-authority changes, external PRs, unresolved security/provenance compromise, or consequential external actions; human review required.

controller_rules: D may reallocate ordinary work through this file without changing scheduler cadence or agent permissions.
A and B may challenge an assignment as low-value but may not alter governance or merge their own substantive work.
C conclusions are technically independent from D and producers; the latest exact-head verdict controls integration readiness.
Audit independently evaluates whether D's allocations and integrations are effective.
If this file becomes stale or unavailable, A/B/C use their role-specific safe fallback without expanding authority.
For Tier-2 integration candidates, branch freshness is a readiness condition for the final C verdict: refresh first, then exact-head CI and independent C review.

After a fresh Tier-2 head is submitted for final C review, D should avoid nonurgent main-mutating controller updates until the merge decision is complete; urgent safety or control corrections still take precedence.
